verdict.rationale: BILL Spend & Expense explicitly advertises 'custom approval policies,' budget/card controls, and AI-powered spend management that keeps 'every transaction... controlled, categorized, and automatically compliant,' which supports policy codification and automated compliance. However, the evidence never details rule granularity (by category, role, or context) or an explicit exception-only human-review workflow for auto-approved in-policy spend. Missing for 10: documentation of multi-dimensional policy rule configuration (category/role/context), explicit auto-approval vs. exception-routing logic, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this behavior.
